formula.en: The first philosophers look for a single natural origin of the world instead of myths

en: Everything comes from one primary substance, the arche

Natural events have natural causes, not the whims of gods

formula.en: The world is ordered by number and harmony, and the soul is immortal and reborn

en: Number underlies all things
Musical harmony mirrors the order of the cosmos
Transmigration of souls and a strict communal way of life
Mathematics as a way of purifying the soul

formula.en: Being is one and unchanging; motion and plurality are illusions of the senses

en: Only being is; non-being is not
Change and coming-to-be are unthinkable
Reason outranks the evidence of the senses

formula.en: Order in the state begins with cultivating the noble person and respect for elders

en: Humaneness (ren) is the chief virtue
Ritual (li) and filial piety
The "noble person" improves through study

formula.en: Life is full of suffering, it has a cause, and liberation from it is possible

en: The Four Noble Truths
Nothing is permanent and there is no unchanging self
Everything arises in dependence on other things

formula.en: Paid teachers of wisdom and rhetoric: truth and law depend on people

en: "Man is the measure of all things" (Protagoras)
Laws are human convention, not nature

formula.en: The world is made of indivisible particles, atoms, moving in the void

en: Atoms are eternal, indivisible and differ in shape and arrangement

formula.en: Impartial care for all and common benefit instead of lavish rituals

en: Impartial care (jian ai) for all people alike

Against costly funerals and court music

formula.en: Happiness lies in virtue and living by nature, free of wealth and convention

en: Virtue is the only good

formula.en: The state rests on strict laws, rewards and punishments, not on virtue

en: A world of Forms and a world of things

formula.en: Nothing can be known for certain: suspend judgement and find peace

en: Every argument can be met by an equal one
Suspension of judgement (epoché)

The modes of doubt, collected by Sextus Empiricus

formula.en: The goal of life is pleasure understood as peace of mind and freedom from pain

en: The highest good is tranquillity (ataraxia), not luxury

en: Virtue is the only good; all else is indifferent

en: Four means of knowledge: perception, inference, comparison and testimony
A five-part syllogism

Navya-Nyaya, the "new logic", from the 13th century

formula.en: The Church Fathers bring Christian faith together with Greek philosophy

en: Faith and reason do not contradict each other
Doctrines of the Trinity and the nature of Christ

Augustine: grace, free will and the City of God

formula.en: The Buddhist "middle way": things have no essence of their own — all is empty

en: Emptiness (shunyata): everything exists only through interdependence

formula.en: Everything flows from the ineffable One, and the soul can return to it

en: A hierarchy: the One, Intellect, Soul, matter

formula.en: The Buddhist "consciousness-only" school: the world we perceive is made by the mind

en: External objects are manifestations of consciousness

formula.en: Awakening comes not from books but from directly seeing one's own nature in meditation

formula.en: The self and the ultimate reality, Brahman, are one and the same

formula.en: Islamic theology that defends doctrine with rational argument

en: The Mu'tazila: God's unity and justice, and human free will
The Ash'arites: God's will creates everything at every moment
Atomism: the world consists of instants and particles God creates

formula.en: Arabic-language philosophers develop Aristotle and the Neoplatonists and pass them on to Europe

en: Translating and interpreting Greek philosophy
Reason and revelation lead to the same truth
Al-Farabi: the virtuous city ruled by a sage
Avicenna: the distinction between essence and existence
Averroes: commentaries on Aristotle read throughout Europe

formula.en: Confucianism renewed in answer to Buddhism and Taoism: the world is principle and energy

en: All things consist of principle (li) and vital energy (qi)
Zhu Xi: grasp principle by investigating things

formula.en: Only individual things exist; general concepts are just names

en: Universals are words and concepts, not real entities
Ockham's razor: do not multiply entities beyond necessity

formula.en: The philosophy of medieval schools: reason uses logic to clarify faith

en: "Faith seeking understanding" (Anselm)

formula.en: Reviving classical learning, with a focus on human dignity and earthly life

en: Reading Latin and Greek authors in the original
Human dignity and freedom
A liberal-arts education for the citizen

formula.en: All knowledge comes from experience: at birth the mind is a blank slate

en: No innate ideas: the mind as a tabula rasa (Locke)

Hume: causation is a habit of mind, not an observed link

formula.en: Certain knowledge comes from reason, not the senses: "I think, therefore I am"

en: Doubt everything except thinking itself

formula.en: "Dare to use your own reason": reason, liberty and progress

en: Reason and science instead of authority and prejudice
Natural rights and the social contract
Religious tolerance and freedom of speech
Separation of powers
The Encyclopédie as a compendium of knowledge

formula.en: The world as we know it is shaped by the activity of mind and spirit

en: Kant: the mind itself supplies the forms of knowledge
The categorical imperative
Fichte: everything derives from the activity of the "I"
Hegel: history is the unfolding of absolute spirit through contradiction

formula.en: The right action brings the greatest happiness to the greatest number

en: An act is judged by its consequences
Happiness and suffering can be weighed and added up

Mill: higher and lower pleasures, individual liberty

en: The law of three stages: theological, metaphysical, positive
Society is studied by the science of sociology

"Know in order to foresee"

formula.en: Truth is grasped by intuition, in unity with nature, without intermediaries

en: The divine is present in nature and in every person
Self-reliance instead of deference to authority
Simple living in nature (Thoreau's Walden)
Civil disobedience to unjust laws

formula.en: A search for integral knowledge in which faith, reason and life are inseparable

en: The all-unity of the world (Solovyov)
Sobornost: a free unity of people in love
Freedom and creativity of the person (Berdyaev)

formula.en: Existence precedes essence: each person chooses what to become

en: Freedom and responsibility for one's choices
Anxiety, despair and the absurd as human experience
Authentic existence instead of living "like everyone else"
Kierkegaard and Nietzsche as forerunners; Sartre and Camus as 20th-century classics

formula.en: History is driven by class struggle, and society is shaped by how people produce

en: Historical materialism: the economy is the base of society
Class struggle and the succession of social formations

The goal of a classless communist society

formula.en: The meaning and truth of an idea are tested by its practical consequences

en: An idea is a tool for action
Truth is what proves itself in experience
Knowledge is always open to revision
Democracy and learning by doing (Dewey)

formula.en: Humanity should unite, overcome death and go out into space

en: The "common task": resurrecting the ancestors through science (Fyodorov)
Space exploration as humanity's task
Humans as an active force of evolution

formula.en: "Back to the things themselves": describing experience as it is given to consciousness

en: Consciousness is always of something (intentionality)

formula.en: Philosophical problems are solved by clear analysis of language and logic

en: The logic of Frege and Russell as a tool of philosophy

formula.en: Japanese philosophers join Western thought with the Buddhist idea of "nothingness"

en: "Pure experience" before the split into subject and object (Nishida)

en: Language is a system of signs; meaning lies in differences (Saussure)
Myths and kinship work like a language (Lévi-Strauss)

formula.en: Only what can be verified by experience or logic is meaningful

en: The verification principle
Metaphysics is meaningless
A unified science in the language of logic and physics
The Vienna Circle; Popper answered with falsifiability

formula.en: Black intellectuals assert the worth of African culture against colonialism

en: Pride in African heritage
A critique of colonialism and racism
Poetry as a form of philosophical statement

formula.en: Incredulity towards grand narratives: truth, reason and the self are historically shaped

en: The end of grand narratives of progress and truth (Lyotard)
Deconstruction of texts (Derrida)
